original: We have visited the museum last Sunday
correction: We visited the museum last Sunday
explanation: Use the past simple with a finished time like last Sunday.

original: She is studying English from two years
correction: She has been studying English for two years
explanation: Use the present perfect continuous with for and a duration.

correction: I want a coffee
explanation: Want is a state verb and is not used in the continuous.

original: Last year we builded a house
correction: Last year we built a house
explanation: Build is irregular: built.

correction: Did she call you yesterday
explanation: After did the verb is in the base form.

original: Look at those black clouds, it will rain
correction: Look at those black clouds, it is going to rain
explanation: Use going to for a prediction based on evidence.

original: I will call you when I will get home
correction: I will call you when I get home
explanation: Use the present simple after when, not will.

original: I watched TV when the phone rang
correction: I was watching TV when the phone rang
explanation: Use the past continuous for the action in progress.

correction: My mother cooks very well
explanation: Third person singular needs -s.

correction: Do your parents live here
explanation: Parents is plural, so use do.

original: There is two bottles on the shelf
correction: There are two bottles on the shelf
explanation: Use there are with a plural noun.

correction: My friends are very kind
explanation: Plural subject needs are.

correction: Everyone is waiting for you
explanation: Everyone takes a singular verb.

correction: They must leave early
explanation: Modal verbs are followed by the base form without to.

original: He decided going to the city
correction: He decided to go to the city
explanation: Decide is followed by the to-infinitive.

correction: Thank you for helping me
explanation: After a preposition use the -ing form.

correction: They have written three emails
explanation: Use the past participle after have.

correction: My brother is playing guitar now
explanation: The continuous needs the verb be.

original: I make my exercises every night
correction: I do my exercises every night
explanation: Use do for exercises and tasks.

correction: He is a university student
explanation: University starts with a consonant sound, so use a.

correction: I bought a new laptop yesterday
explanation: A singular countable noun needs an article.

original: The money does not buy happiness
correction: Money does not buy happiness
explanation: Do not use the in general statements.

original: We saw a dog. A dog was very big
correction: We saw a dog. The dog was very big
explanation: Use the for something already mentioned.

original: She goes to the bed at ten
correction: She goes to bed at ten
explanation: No article with go to bed.

correction: The meeting starts at 9 o'clock
explanation: Use at with clock times.

original: My sister lives in 12 Oak Street
correction: My sister lives at 12 Oak Street
explanation: Use at with a specific address.

correction: She is afraid of dogs
explanation: Afraid is followed by of.

correction: I am waiting for you outside
explanation: Wait needs the preposition for.

original: I called him for ask about the job
correction: I called him to ask about the job
explanation: Use to + verb to express purpose.

original: They arrived to the airport late
correction: They arrived at the airport late
explanation: Use arrive at with a specific place.

correction: We travelled by plane
explanation: Use by with means of transport.

correction: I have three sisters
explanation: The noun after three must be plural.

correction: Those men are my neighbours
explanation: Man has an irregular plural: men.

correction: She gave me some information
explanation: Information is uncountable.

correction: This house is very old
explanation: Use this with a singular noun.

correction: He is my cousin
explanation: Use the subject pronoun he before the verb.

correction: Maria loves her job
explanation: The possessive agrees with the owner: Maria is female.

correction: I feel very nervous
explanation: Feel does not take a reflexive pronoun here.

correction: It is cold in the room
explanation: English needs a subject: it.

original: The teacher who I met her was kind
correction: The teacher who I met was kind
explanation: Do not repeat the object with a relative pronoun.

correction: She drinks coffee every morning
explanation: The object goes right after the verb.

correction: He has an old house
explanation: The adjective goes before the noun.

correction: What do you want to eat
explanation: Questions need an auxiliary before the subject.

original: I wonder where is the bank
correction: I wonder where the bank is
explanation: Indirect questions keep the statement order.

original: We go usually to the park
correction: We usually go to the park
explanation: Frequency adverbs go before the main verb.

original: I am very constipated, I have a cold
correction: I have a bad cold
explanation: Constipated is a false friend of the Spanish word constipado.

original: I did a mistake in the test
correction: I made a mistake in the test
explanation: The collocation is make a mistake.

original: He said me that he was tired
correction: He told me that he was tired
explanation: Tell needs a person as object.

original: Can you borrow me some money
correction: Can you lend me some money
explanation: Lend is to give temporarily.

original: I don't have much friends here
correction: I don't have many friends here
explanation: Friends is countable, so use many.

correction: She doesn't want anything
explanation: Do not use a double negative.

original: My house is more big than yours
correction: My house is bigger than yours
explanation: Short adjectives use -er.

original: If I would be rich I would buy a boat
correction: If I were rich I would buy a boat
explanation: Do not use would in the if-clause.

correction: The soup is very delicious
explanation: Use very, not too, for a high positive degree.

correction: I agree with you
explanation: Agree is a verb, not an adjective.

original: I am boring in the class
correction: I am bored in the class
explanation: Bored describes the feeling, boring the cause.

correction: She is twenty years old
explanation: English uses be for age.

correction: I explained the problem to him
explanation: Explain needs to before the person.

original: Yesterday I lost my cellphone and my keys also
correction: Yesterday I lost my phone and my keys too
explanation: Also does not go at the end of a sentence.

correction: He suggested that I go
explanation: Suggest does not take object plus to-infinitive.
